+def check_n_neighbors(n_neighbors):
+    """Check to make sure ``n_neighbors`` is a valid, positive integer.
+
+    Parameters
+    ----------
+    n_neighbors : int
+        The number of neighbors to check.
+
+    Returns
+    -------
+    n_neighbors : int
+        The validated value of ``n_neighbors``.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(n_neighbors, numbers.Integral):
+        raise TypeError(
+            "n_neighbors does not take %s value, "
+            "enter integer value" %
+            type(n_neighbors))
+
+    if n_neighbors <= 0:
+        raise ValueError(
+            "Expected n_neighbors > 0. Got %d" %
+            n_neighbors
+        )
+
+    return n_neighbors
+
